newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq rumbles ahead to close at record level.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq rumbles ahead to close at record level.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks rallied sharply on Monday, pushing the Nasdaq Composite index to a record closing high.

On a day that saw the Dow Jones industrial average close above the 6,000 level for the first time in its history, the Nasdaq Composite gained 8.09 points to close unofficially at 1256.36, eclipsing its prior all-time high close of 1250.87, set on October 7.
As ever, technology stocks fueled the Nasdaq rally, with Intel Corp rising two points to 107-3/8 ahead of release of third quarter earnings.
After the close, Intel reported third quarter earnings of $1.48 per share, well ahead of First Call's $1.25 per share consensus estimate.

"The desire to own first tier technology companies is still strong," said Scott Bleier, chief investment strategist at Prime Charter Ltd. "That demand is now filtering down to some secondary and tertiary names."
Personal computer makers Dell Computer Corp and Gateway 2000 Inc were among the top performers. Dell surged 4-1/4 to 84-7/8 and Gateway gained 3-5/8 to 53-3/8.
